# NFL Daily — 2026-10-25 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is out again Sunday vs. the Bengals; Ian Rapoport reports he's "likely to return" for Week 8 at Buffalo. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/myles-garrett-lamar-jackson-return-jay-glazer-update)
- Colts are expected to field trade-deadline inquiries on star players including RB Jonathan Taylor, DT DeForest Buckner and G Quenton Nelson, per sources. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50272352/sources-decisions-loom-colts-nfl-trade-deadline)
- NFL and NFLPA are jointly reviewing how the Eagles handled QB Jalen Hurts' blood clot diagnosis, after the union called for an investigation. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50276432/nfl-nflpa-handling-joint-review-jalen-hurts-diagnosis)
- Panthers OT Taylor Moton fractured his fibula vs. the Buccaneers and is out indefinitely. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50279064/panthers-taylor-moton-carted-ankle-fibula-injury) — also [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2114448328792404407)
- Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks are both ruled out for Monday night's game vs. the Cowboys. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50269752/eagles-devonta-smith-dontayvion-wicks-vs-cowboys)

## Transactions
- Browns DT Maliek Collins agreed to a two-year, $30M extension with $23M guaranteed, per his agent. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50275489/browns-maliek-collins-lands-2-year-extension-agent-says)

## Injuries
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is out for Sunday's game vs. the Bengals; he's considered "likely to return" for Week 8 at Buffalo, per Ian Rapoport. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Panthers OT Taylor Moton (ankle/fibula) is out indefinitely after fracturing his fibula vs. the Buccaneers. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-10-25 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Ravens blew a 13-0 halftime lead and lost 35-13 to the Bengals, falling to 4-3 and 0-2 in the AFC North for the first time in 19 years. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2114446087004037459)
- Coach Jesse Minter said the team will know more about QB Lamar Jackson's (ankle) availability for next week's game at Buffalo over the next couple of days; Tyler Huntley started again Sunday. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2114450499558621378)
- Starting RG Vega Ioane left in the first quarter with a knee injury and didn't return; Minter had no update on his status after the game. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2114450198650900875) — also [Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2114450059161137606)

# Rivals — 2026-10-25 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Bengals routed the Ravens 35-13, scoring 35 unanswered second-half points after trailing 13-0 at the half. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7723995/2026/10/25/bengals-ravens-nfl-week-7-result-takeaways/)
- Browns (5-2) stayed atop the AFC North, beating the Titans on a last-second field goal for their fifth win in six games. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7723535/2026/10/25/browns-titans-nfl-week-7-result-takeaways/)
- Steelers beat the Saints 16-10 in the NFL's first regular-season game in Paris, their third straight win, behind a run-heavy attack from Jaylen Warren, Rico Dowdle and Aaron Rodgers. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7723123/2026/10/25/steelers-saints-paris-nfl-week-7-result-takeaways/)
- Chiefs OT Josh Simmons was told to leave a team meeting by coach Andy Reid and QB Patrick Mahomes; he later apologized. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50268181/sources-josh-simmons-told-leave-chiefs-team-meeting)

## Transactions
- Browns DT Maliek Collins agreed to a two-year, $30M extension with $23M guaranteed, per his agent. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50275489/browns-maliek-collins-lands-2-year-extension-agent-says)
- Bills S C.J. Gardner-Johnson was placed on the Reserve/Suspended list. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

## Injuries
- Browns OT Tytus Howard was evaluated for a possible concussion and was questionable to return vs. the Titans. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
